mapper.select: SELECT user_sq AS userSq, notification_settings_all_notice_yn AS allNoticeYn, notification_settings_recruit_notice_yn AS recruitNoticeYn, notification_settings_comment_notice_yn AS commentNoticeYn, notification_settings_scrap_company_notice_yn AS scrapCompanyNoticeYn FROM TBL_NOTIFICATION_SETTING_S WHERE user_sq = #{userSq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_NOTIFICATION_SETTING_S ( user_sq, notification_settings_all_notice_yn, notification_settings_recruit_notice_yn, notification_settings_comment_notice_yn, notification_settings_scrap_company_notice_yn ) VALUES (#{userSq}, 'Y','Y','Y','Y') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_sq = user_sq
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_NOTIFICATION_SETTING_S SET notification_settings_all_notice_yn = COALESCE(#{req.allNoticeYn}, notification_settings_all_notice_yn), notification_settings_recruit_notice_yn = COALESCE(#{req.recruitNoticeYn}, notification_settings_recruit_notice_yn), notification_settings_comment_notice_yn = COALESCE(#{req.commentNoticeYn}, notification_settings_comment_notice_yn), notification_settings_scrap_company_notice_yn = COALESCE(#{req.scrapCompanyNoticeYn}, notification_settings_scrap_company_notice_yn) WHERE user_sq = #{userSq}
